command:
set -eo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== muscle on mafft's own extraction: the identical 906 bytes, not a second copy =="
IN=gpcr906.fa
WANT=$(grep -c '^>' $IN)
INRES=$(awk '!/^>/{n+=length($0)} END{printf "%.0f", n}' $IN)

# -super5, NOT -align. MEASURED: muscle5 -align did not finish these 906 sequences inside a
# 90-minute TTL on this box, where mafft --auto aligns them in 3 seconds. muscle5's docs
# suggest -align up to ~1000 sequences; at 906 it is already past what a recipe can budget.
# -super5 is the large-input path and is what makes this workload runnable at all.
#
# -threads is pinned, and it is STILL not enough. Measured: two runs of this exact spec on
# byte-identical input gave 5633 then 5636 columns. -super5's subset selection is randomised
# and pinning threads does not settle it, so the column count is an OBSERVATION here and
# nothing about gap placement may be asserted -- only sequence content, which did hold across
# both runs. mafft on the same bytes gives 4340 twice and does assert its count.
T0=$(date +%s)
muscle -super5 $IN -output aln.fa -threads 8 2> muscle.log
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))

# An alignment may only insert gaps, never alter sequence content.
SEQS=$(grep -c '^>' aln.fa)
RES=$(awk '!/^>/{gsub(/-/,""); n+=length($0)} END{printf "%.0f", n}' aln.fa)
read -r LMIN LMAX <<<"$(awk '/^>/{if(l!=""){if(l<mn||mn=="")mn=l; if(l>mx)mx=l}; l=0; next}
  {l+=length($0)} END{if(l<mn)mn=l; if(l>mx)mx=l; print mn, mx}' aln.fa)"

# A cross-tool identity, not a score: strip the gaps from BOTH alignments and the 906
# sequences must come back byte-identical. Each task already asserts its own residue COUNT,
# but this asserts the CONTENT agrees between two independent aligners -- so a tool that
# silently substituted or reordered residues fails even though its own count balances.
ungap() { awk '/^>/{if(id!="")print id"\t"s; id=substr($1,2); s=""; next}
  {gsub(/-/,""); s=s $0} END{if(id!="")print id"\t"s}' "$1" | sort; }
ungap aln.fa       > muscle_seqs.tsv
ungap mafft_aln.fa > mafft_seqs.tsv
IDENT=$(comm -12 muscle_seqs.tsv mafft_seqs.tsv | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

# Column occupancy, reported for both. NOT gap-free columns: measured, no column of either
# alignment is gap-free, because 906 class-A GPCRs have wildly variable N- and C-termini --
# a gap-free count is 0 for both tools and distinguishes nothing. Occupancy thresholds do.
occ() {
  awk -v t1=0.5 -v t9=0.9 '
    /^>/ {if(s!=""){n++; L=length(s); for(i=1;i<=L;i++) if(substr(s,i,1)!="-") c[i]++}; s=""; next}
    {s=s $0}
    END {if(s!=""){n++; L=length(s); for(i=1;i<=L;i++) if(substr(s,i,1)!="-") c[i]++}
         h=0; d=0; for(i=1;i<=L;i++){ if(c[i]>=t1*n) h++; if(c[i]>=t9*n) d++ }
         printf "%d %d %d", L, h, d}' "$1"
}
read -r MLEN MH50 MH90 <<<"$(occ aln.fa)"
read -r FLEN FH50 FH90 <<<"$(occ mafft_aln.fa)"
MGAP=$(awk -v r="$RES" -v n="$SEQS" -v l="$MLEN" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", 100*(1-r/(n*l))}')
FGAP=$(awk -v r="$RES" -v n="$SEQS" -v l="$FLEN" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", 100*(1-r/(n*l))}')

{
  echo "input_sequences      $WANT   want exactly 906   (mafft's gpcr906.fa, byte-identical)"
  echo "input_residues       $INRES   want exactly 311969"
  echo "aligned_sequences    $SEQS   want == input_sequences"
  echo "aligned_residues     $RES   want exactly 311969   [CONSERVATION: gaps only, no edits]"
  echo "row_length           $LMIN..$LMAX   want equal (it is an alignment); value NOT asserted"
  echo "ungapped_identical   $IDENT   want exactly 906   [CROSS-TOOL: same residues, both aligners]"
  echo "muscle_columns       $MLEN   >=50% occupied $MH50   >=90% $MH90   gaps ${MGAP}%"
  echo "mafft_columns        $FLEN   >=50% occupied $FH50   >=90% $FH90   gaps ${FGAP}%   (same input bytes)"
  echo "wall_s               $WALL"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$WANT"  -eq 906
test "$INRES" = '311969'
test "$SEQS"  -eq "$WANT"
test "$RES"   = '311969'
test "$LMIN"  -eq "$LMAX"
test "$IDENT" -eq 906
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
